title: jq lab
description: Write and fix jq filters against JSON inputs, see every output and which expected outputs pass.
needs: an object with filters ([{ id, filter }]) and inputs ([{ id, value: any JSON }]), at least one of each, and optionally expected ([{ filter, input, outputs: [every output] }])

tools.name: addFilter
tools.description: Add a filter; it gets the next free id (f1, f2, …).

tools.name: removeFilter
tools.description: Remove a filter and its expectations.

tools.name: reorderFilters
tools.description: Move a filter to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: addInput
tools.description: Add a JSON input; it gets the next free id (i1, i2, …).

tools.name: removeInput
tools.description: Remove an input and its expectations.

tools.name: reorderInputs
tools.description: Move an input to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setExpected
tools.description: Pin what a filter should output for an input: the list of every output, in order ([x] for a single output x).

tools.name: clearExpected
tools.description: Remove the expectation of a filter for an input.

tools.name: outputs
tools.description: Every filter × input: the outputs or the error, the expected outputs and whether they pass.

tools.name: inputShape
tools.description: A compact type sketch of an input, like {a: number, items: [{id: string}]}.

tools.name: getInput
tools.description: The part of an input at a JSON pointer: "" for all of it, "/items/0" for the first item.
